subject: sea hare
title: A Slow Sea Slug Beats Lobsters by Jamming Their Noses

scenes.text: A soft slug with no armour walks away from lobster attacks.
The California sea hare can't run, bite or hide. A spiny lobster should win every time.
Instead, the slug squirts two clouds: purple ink and a thick white goo.
The goo sticks to the lobster's smell sensors on its antennae and gums them up.
The ink adds chemicals that taste like food, so the lobster stops to groom and pick at nothing.
The purple even comes from the red seaweed it eats. Dinner, turned into a weapon.

description:
When a spiny lobster attacks, the California sea hare releases purple ink and white opaline. Studies at Georgia State University found the sticky opaline clogs the lobster's chemical sensors and triggers grooming, while the ink's food-like chemicals distract it.
The purple pigment comes from the red algae the sea hare eats.
Which animal defence is the strangest you've seen?
first_comment: Bonus: the ink's food-like chemicals can make a lobster try to eat the cloud itself. Which ocean animal has the weirdest defence?
